sections.description:
Manage Cloudflare from your WordPress admin: WAF rules, zones, DNS, analytics, cache, bots, SSL, alerts, Turnstile, Page Rules migration, IP access rules, security events and email routing, built for agencies running many client sites.

Features:
  • WAF Rules: deploy 5 battle-tested security rules to one zone or dozens in one click
  • Rule Profiles and Domain Profiles: save rule setups and zone groups for repeat deploys
  • Zones: every zone in your account with its plan, tagged with flares like WooCommerce or Staging
  • DNS Manager: full DNS record management with all 21 Cloudflare record types
  • Zone Status: every zone at a glance, plus a detail view with charts, top countries, pages, status codes, devices and security events
  • Clients & Reports: link clients to their sites and send white-label Cloudflare stats emails by hand or automatically every month
  • Zone Controls: Under Attack mode, Dev Mode, purge by URL, hostname, prefix or tag, Smart Tiered Cache, security headers and more
  • Bot Control: AI crawler policy, managed robots.txt and Bot Fight Mode across many zones
  • SSL & Insights: certificate expiry, HTTPS checks with safe one-click fixes, and Cloudflare Security Insights
  • Alerts & Health: Cloudflare alerts by email or webhook, and origin Health Checks
  • Turnstile: create, edit and rotate widgets for client sites and copy their keys
  • Page Rules: find deprecated Page Rules and migrate redirects and cache rules in one click
  • IP Access Rules: account-wide allow, block and challenge by IP, range, country or ASN
  • Security Events: recent firewall events per zone (Pro plan zones)
  • Email Routing: forwarding rules, catch-all and destination addresses
  • Multi-account support, user access control and encrypted credentials
sections.frequently asked questions:
Does this work on Cloudflare Free plans?

Yes. Every screen works on Free plans. Security Events and Health Checks need a Pro plan or higher.

What API Token permissions do I need?

Zone → Zone WAF → Edit, Zone → Zone → Read and Zone → DNS → Edit for the core features. Each other screen needs only its own permission: Zone Settings Edit and Cache Purge for Zone Controls (plus Managed Headers Edit for security headers), Analytics Read for Zone Status and Security Events, Bot Management Edit for Bot Control, SSL and Certificates Read and Security Center Insights for SSL & Insights, Notifications Edit and Health Checks Edit for Alerts & Health, Turnstile Edit for Turnstile, Page Rules Edit, Single Redirect Edit and Cache Rules Edit for Page Rules, Account Firewall Access Rules Edit for IP Access Rules, and Email Routing Addresses and Rules Edit for Email Routing.

Can I manage multiple client sites?

Yes. Connect multiple Cloudflare accounts, save Rule Profiles and Domain Profiles, and tag zones with flares so the right rules go to the right sites.

Where can I get the free version?

The full plugin is free and open-source on GitHub. The Pro version adds automatic updates in WordPress admin and priority support.
